text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's fishing banner flies high as
proof of
her victory over Эйсин Флэш in
the Arima Kinen.
As promised, a new
clue from the Book of Secrets
is hers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It says Eden is at the bottom of the
ocean and
can only be reached after
defeating four powerful
opponents and
collecting four clues. The whole
thing is
extremely fishy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Who wrote the Book of Secrets? And
where did it
come from? No answers are
available, but the
only path left is
forward. Eden awaits you, Gold
Ship!
Most likely, anyway!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
